name: pi_screen_setup
description: Comprehensive display configuration for Raspberry Pi including HDMI, DSI, DPI, and Composite outputs with KMS/DRM support.
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Configure display outputs on Raspberry Pi devices. Supports HDMI (single and dual), DSI displays (official 7-inch and third-party), DPI/GPIO displays, and Composite output. Features include display presets for popular screens (Waveshare, Elecrow), rotation, KMS/CMA configuration, and automatic migration from existing display settings.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.0.0: Complete rework. The board read from the firmware's revision code; the boot files read as the firmware applies them and repaired after a Volumio update; settings rebuilt from the plugin's own boot files when lost; one root helper in place of twelve sudo grants; a kernel mode for every HDMI row and a generated EDID for panels with their own timings; bundled Waveshare overlays; SPI panels; graphics memory per board; presets database 1.9.0 with 55 more screen names. Before updating from 0.8.x, export presets you authored in the Preset Manager and import them after.
